documents.finding: The pinned repository uses the MIT licence and requires preservation of its copyright and permission notice.
The pinned README describes a multilingual card database, documents API access, states that the database is MIT-licensed, and states that it is not affiliated with Nintendo or The Pokemon Company.
The pinned source contains the exact Japanese set-code to English identification map frozen in Stackr's local source artifact.

requiredConditions: Keep the authentic printed language primary and label English only as supplemental identification.
Use only an exact Japanese set code from the hash-bound source; do not infer a match from a translated title.
Preserve the TCGdex copyright, MIT notice, exact source revision, and provenance.
Do not treat this metadata evidence as artwork, set-logo, symbol, product-image, canonical-write, or model-training permission.
Disable the source-specific runtime lane on provenance failure, source withdrawal, or a substantiated rights complaint.
